---
title: "About me"
---

Hi, my name is **Ludo**.

I'm in my second year of the Master's programme [Methodology, Statistics and Data Science](https://www.uu.nl/en/masters/methodology-statistics-and-data-science){target="_blank"} at Utrecht University. My interest in statistical methods developed during my Bachelor's in Sociology. My main interest is in *Bayesian methods*.

I have experience in both *research* and *teaching*. I am currently working as a student reasearch-assistant on designing the *data-cleaning* pipeline for the project [*Meer Uren Werkt!*](https://www.uu.nl/organisatie/sociologie/meer-uren-werkt){target="_blank"} at the department of Sociology, Utrecht University. Besides, as a student-assistant for the department of Methodology, Statistics & Data Science, Utrecht University, I have taught *undergraduate statistics* courses. Outside the academic environment, I have taught classes about *fake news* and *financial management* at secondary schools throughout the Netherlands.
